Translation of confidential letter No. 93 character
Tsung( 珠 ), from the Chief of Shanghai Public
Safety Bureau to the Commissioner of Police, S.M.P.

Sir,

We have received confidential order No. 1267
from the Municipality of Greater Shanghai transmitting
confidential dispatch No. 2818 character Ching( 警 )
from the Ministry of Home Affairs which states as
follows:-

"We have received confidential letter No. 372
from the Propaganda Committee of the Central
Kuomintang Headquarters requesting the suppression
by the Shanghai Authorities of a book entitled
"Art Methods", written by Chuan Kiang Hao( 川江浩 )
and translated by Lee Sung Pao( 森堡 ), and
published by the Dah Kiang( 大江 )Bookstore,
Shanghai." The book contains proletarian doctrines."

Upon receipt of the order from the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai, we have ascertained that the
bookstore in question is located at Nos. 1 and 2 (old
number 584), Ching Shing( 景星里 )Li, North Honan Road near
Tsepoo Road. . Apart from applying for a search
warrant from the Shanghai Special District Court, we
request you to send detectives to assist our officers
in conducting a search of the said bookstore and to
instruct the bookstore to hand over all copies of the
book "Art Methods" ( 藝術方法 ) as well as the paper-
mache blocks, all of which we request you to hand over
to our officers to be brought to this Bureau for
destruction.

(Seal) Wen Hung Eng.
December 5, 1933.

本局接到大上海市政府轉來之內政部密電第2818號「警」字，內附市政府密令第1267號，內容如下：-
